title: StrokeGuard: A Multi-Agent Guided System for Prehospital Stroke Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2608.24555v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prehospital stroke assessment aims to accurately identify stroke symptoms and make rapid decisions through standardized procedures within an extremely narrow time window, thereby saving valuable time for subsequent treatment. In clinical practice, FAST-based scales are widely used for prehospital stroke assessment by issuing instructions that guide subjects to perform specific actions to screen facial, arm, and speech functions. However, in home and community settings, non-clinical users often encounter challenges such as inaccurate descriptions, incomplete symptom observation, and difficult operational procedures, which may lead to inaccurate or biased assessment results. To address these challenges, this paper presents StrokeGuard: a multi-agent guided system designed for prehospital stroke assessment that makes mobile FAST screening more standardized and executable. translated_title: 卒中卫士：一种用于院前卒中评估的多智能体引导系统
translated_abstract: 院前卒中评估旨在通过标准化程序在极窄的时间窗口内准确识别卒中症状并做出快速决策，从而为后续治疗节省宝贵时间。在临床实践中，基于FAST的量表被广泛用于院前卒中评估，通过发出指令引导受试者执行特定动作来筛查面部、手臂和言语功能。然而，在家庭和社区环境中，非临床用户经常面临描述不准确、症状观察不完整以及操作流程困难等挑战，这可能导致评估结果不准确或有偏差。为了解决这些挑战，本文提出了StrokeGuard：一种专为院前卒中评估设计的多智能体引导系统，使移动FAST筛查更加标准化和可执行。具体而言，为克服传统单年龄段的局限性，该系统采用多智能体协作机制，提供分步指导、实时反馈和个性化提示，从而提升非专业用户在院前环境中的评估准确性和操作可行性。
tldr: 本文提出StrokeGuard多智能体引导系统，通过标准化和可执行的移动FAST筛查流程，帮助非临床用户在家庭和社区环境中更准确、可靠地进行院前卒中评估。
en_tdlr: This paper presents StrokeGuard, a multi-agent guided system that enables more accurate and reliable prehospital stroke assessment for non-clinical users in home and community settings through standardized and executable mobile FAST screening.
